text: The previous trading day's high must be considered when identifying the resistance area (author: "day's high should be considered and a zone should be drawn").
implemented_by: build_zone_a / build_zone_b (ceiling = the previous session's maximum high)

text: Reading of A01: the zone ceiling IS the previous session's highest high, and an unrelated lower swing high may not replace it.
source: Phase 3.4 brief interpretation of the author's words

text: If the previous session contains multiple highs, a zone connecting all of them is considered (principle only; the author gave no numbers).
How many highs make 'multiple highs': distinct touch groups >= b_min_touches (default 2).
Maximum difference between highs: a local high within b_tolerance_points (default 5.0) of the day's high joins the cluster.
Minimum candle separation: members closer than b_min_separation_candles (default 2) count as one touch.
Maximum cluster width: NOT limited; the width is recorded and the day-high spike is never discarded.
Isolated spikes: the day's high is always part of the zone (b_spike_policy ALWAYS_INCLUDE_DAY_HIGH); excluding a spike above a shelf is a diagnostic option only.
Candidate B lower boundary: the lowest body top among the cluster members (default) or the body top of the day-high candle (the 'wick-only' convention of the PDR charts).
Candidate A lower boundary: the body top of the day-high candle (zone = body top to wick high, the guide's 'candle body to upper wick'). The author gave no number.
What counts as a 'high' of the cluster: a local high not lower than its b_local_high_k (default 1) neighbours on each side (non-strict).
Equal day highs: the first candle that made the session's highest high anchors the zone.

The next session must open gap up and the price must return to / interact with the selected zone (any candle whose range overlaps the zone +/- proximity); the confirmation candle comes after the interaction candle.

Open must lie above the zone ceiling (legacy PDR-011, a proposal) - preserved, not an author rule. With the ceiling at the previous-day high this requires the gap to clear the whole previous range; the open_vs_zone=ANY sensitivity is reported beside it.
Gap up means the open is above the official previous close by more than gap_min_points (0).

A LONG entry needs one good green body candle OR a lower price rejection candle OR a hammer candle (author: "One good green body candle or lower price rejection candle or hammer candle is required for entry").
Reading of A04: OR logic; every pattern that passes is recorded; one signal per candle.
source: Phase 3.4 brief interpretation of the author's words

text: Good green body: bullish close, body >= green_body_min of the range, upper wick <= green_upper_wick_max of the range (thresholds from the Phase 2.2 owner recommendation, not from the author).

Lower-price rejection: lower wick >= reject_wick_to_body_min x body, close within the top reject_close_fraction_max of the range, and the low reached the zone (low <= zone ceiling + proximity). Candle colour is NOT required (author silent).

Hammer: lower wick >= hammer_wick_to_body_min x body, upper wick <= hammer_upper_wick_max of the range, body in the upper part of the range (body bottom at >= hammer_body_position_min of the range). Candle colour is NOT required (author silent).
The confirmation candle should close above the zone (author: "The candle should close above the zone").
Reading of A05: close > the zone CEILING, strictly. Equal, inside the zone or below the floor is invalid. A lower wick may penetrate the zone; the whole candle need not stay above it.
source: Phase 3.4 brief interpretation of the author's words

text: Numerical tolerance of the threshold comparisons: EPS = 1e-9 on >=/<= boundaries (never applied to the strict close > ceiling).
Entry only after the confirmation candle has completed; fill = open of the 1-minute bar that starts when it ends (existing EXE-FILL-001 convention).
The test stays armed until a candle qualifies or the session ends (wait_policy); the confirmation may not be the interaction candle (preserved legacy rule).
